sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Heard Sri Ramesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Sri Ghanshyam Kumar, learned AGA appearing for the State respondents and perused the record.

2. Present petition has been filed with the following prayers "i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no. 2 to transfer the investigation of Case Crime No.
134 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 328, 313, 354, 376D, 377, 494, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Medical College, District Meerut to other independent investigating agency, i.e. CBCID/Crime Branch, CBI and submit progress report of investigation before this Hon'ble Court within stipulated time.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent no. 2 to produce the mobile location detail/CDR of investigating officer during 13.4.2022 to 3.8.2022 before this Hon'ble Court in Case Crime No. 134 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 328, 313, 354, 376D,
377, 494, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Medical College, District Meerut before this Hon'ble Court within stipulated time,
iii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the Nodal Officer, Reliance Jio, Zone U.P. West to preserved the mobile data/CDR of mobile number 9410005529 of investigating officer for the period of 13.4.2022 to 3.8.2022 for further inquiry."
3. Admitted fact of the present case is that a police report has been submitted wherein some of the accused persons were chargesheeted, however, others were exonerated.
4. Crux of the grievance of the petitioner is that certain persons have wrongly been exonerated.
5. Admittedly, the petitioner has not challenged the police report so submitted exonerating certain accused persons.
In other words, final report against certain accused persons was never challenged.

6. We find that earlier the petitioner approached this Court by filing Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 7642 of 2022 (Preeti Sharma vs. State of U.P. and 2 others), which was disposed of on 21.6.2022 with a direction to the authority concerned to take all action to see that proper investigation as per the provisions of CrPC is carried out in the aforementioned case crime number and be concluded as expeditiously as possible.

sentences.text: It seems that when the petitioner was not still satisfied, he filed a Contempt Application (Civil) No. 4944 of 2022 (Preeti Sharma vs. Rohit singh Sajvan, Senior Superintendent and anohter), which was dismissed vide order dated 18.10.2022 noticing the fact that the matter has again been referred for further investigation.

entities.text: Preeti Sharma vs. Rohit singh Sajvan, Senior Superintendent and anohter
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Now after submission of the chargesheet against some of the accused persons and exoneration of other accused persons, the petitioner has admittedly not filed a protest petition regarding exoneration of other accused persons and has come forward to this Court seeking investigation by some other independent agency.
8. We are not satisfied that any case is made out for granting any indulgence or changing the investigating agency.
Therefore, prayer no. 1 is rejected.

9. Insofar as the prayers no. 2 and 3 are concerned, admittedly police report has already been submitted and it relates to investigation itself only and it has connection with the investigation conducted by the police.
We find no good ground to entertain the said prayers.
Therefore, prayers no
. 2 and 3 are also rejected.
10. Present petition is accordingly dismissed, however, with the observations made hereinabove.
11. If the petitioner has any other grievance in case final report is submitted, he may avail the remedy as may be available to him in law.
